steps.eval: (async () => { await T.skip('feed'); T.run(1.5); const V = T.ball.pos.constructor; const seg = T.ball.segs.filter(s => s.state === 'ring').sort((a, b) => b.mesh.getWorldPosition(new V()).z - a.mesh.getWorldPosition(new V()).z)[0]; const c = seg.mesh.localToWorld(new V(2.3, 0.6, 0)); const m = T.head.mouth(new V()); const a = T.screen(c.x, c.y, c.z), b = T.screen(m.x + 2.2, m.y - 2.6, m.z + 5); const cv = document.getElementById('c'); const fire = (type, x, y) => cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, {clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerId: 1, button: 0, buttons: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', bubbles: true})); fire('pointerdown', a[0], a[1]); for (let i = 1; i <= 12; i++) { fire('pointermove', a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * i / 12, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * i / 12); T.run(0.06); } T.head.blinkIn = 9; T.head.blink = -1; T.run(0.7); })()

note: Scripted through window.T: skips to the feeding stage, grabs the front segment with synthetic pointer events and carries it to the open mouth. Needs a GPU browser, so the published frame was rendered with Chocolate Orange/Niepotrzebne/tools/shot.mjs (ANGLE Metal, 1200x900 at 2x) and applied with shot.mjs set.
